column1: Schedule record of the newest nuclear builds
Years from first structural concrete to commercial operation

Planned = schedule stated at or nearest construction start; actual = first concrete to commercial operation. Some baselines refer to start-up rather than commercial operation (months, not years). † Barakah: last three years operator licensing. ‡ Flamanville measured to grid connection (December 2024). Hinkley C projected to 2030 start-up. Fuqing, Karachi and Taipingling baselines are the weakest-dated; Taipingling 2 (grid July 2026) joins at commercial operation. Sources. IAEA PRIS (actual durations). Baselines: TVO 2003 contract (Olkiluoto); EDF 2007 (Flamanville); Georgia PSC (Vogtle); EDF 2016 and February 2026 guidance (Hinkley C); WNA/WNN statements for the rest, incl. San’ao.
